_comment: ITCAS GPU sweep job spec. Jobs can be listed explicitly in jobs.separate and/or generated in jobs.group via cartesian products (methods x problems x difficulties, with quality only combined for method=itcas). Each expanded entry is ONE Slurm job: one (method, problem, difficulty[, quality]) over a seed range on a single GPU, executing n_concurrent seeds at a time until complete. Fields omitted in a job inherit from defaults. NOTE: budget/batch_size/n_init are problem+difficulty dependent and live in experiments_path (configs/experiments.json), NOT here.

group._comment: Final synthetic benchmarks (every problem in configs/final_problems.json except the two real-world problems, spacecraft_formation_flying_a1/casd_llm): the two new QD-DPP diversity-kernel ablations of the proposed method's batch NDIG acquisition. Both use plain NDIG's quality unchanged and a fixed --quality of 'ndig' baked into the method name (no --quality flag, exactly like c2lse_batch/bes_batch) -- ndig_no_kobj_batch drops k_obj from the L-ensemble (diversity via context alone), ndig_no_kctx_batch drops k_ctx (diversity via the objective-space prediction alone). See itcas/pipeline/loop.py's NDIG_KERNEL_ABLATION / itcas/algorithms/continuous.py's disable_kernel.

Same 15 synthetic problems: the reviewer-requested NDIG-B acquisition-*component* ablations (orthogonal to the QD-DPP batch-diversity kernel ablations above, which touch the DPP kernel, not the quality score). All five use method='itcas' with --quality varying: 'ndig' is the proposed method itself (itcas_ndig), 'ndig_no_infogain' removes the info-gain multiplier (leaves normalized depth alone), 'edig' removes the depth-normalization step (unbounded depth times info gain, reused unchanged), 'efig' is PoF times info gain (reused unchanged), 'ndig_pof_entropy' is the binary entropy of the joint PoF (no depth/info-gain term at all). See itcas/algorithms/quality.py's 'NDIG-B component ablations' docstring section / itcas/reporting/ndig_b_component_ablation_comparison.py, which shows all five together.
